messages:
Anya: Quick idea — rooftop after sprint on Fri 6pm? Pizza, spritzes, and pinball machines (yes the office has one now) — who's up for it? :raised_hands:
Chris: I'm in. Veg pizza pls. :pizza:
Jordan: Count me in! Can we do 7pm instead? I have a call till 6:30.
Anya: 7pm ok — moving it. Also what food? Quick poll: react with :pizza: for pizza, :taco: for tacos, :salad: for salad. I'll order.
Leo: :pizza: (and extra anchovies for @Jordan 😂)
Sam: :salad: — trying to be good. But may cave. ;)
Rita: I'll bring a deck of cards and rules for 'Chair Pong' — simple version of beer pong but with stress balls. No alcohol if people prefer. :card_index:
Jordan: HA. Anchovies ok. Also can someone add it to calendar?
calendar-bot: Event created — 'Rooftop Games + Pizza' Fri Mar 27 19:00-21:00. Invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123
Anya: RSVP in the invite please. If anyone needs rides home DM me. :car:
Chris: Bringing portable speaker. Playlist suggestions welcome. :notes:
Sam: Song rec: 'Summer Friday' playlist https://open.playlist/summerfriday. Also +1 to 7pm.
Leo: Quick note: office pinball might need a quarter — @eng-infra did we leave some change jar? :coin:
